forcedChoices.choice: «transformarse en Guía de Graduados» for 'translate into'
forcedChoices.reason: Spanish «traducirse» does not carry the sense of change of state; «transformarse» does.

forcedChoices.choice: «y ya no está» for 'and is not'
forcedChoices.reason: Spanish forces ser/estar; «estar» reads as no longer present, which the context (disappearance) supports.
